from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,re
paths=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()+subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines())
values=[]
for line in Path('apps/api/.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' not in line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'): continue
    key,value=line.split('=',1);value=value.strip().strip('\"\'')
    if any(term in key for term in ('KEY','TOKEN','PASSWORD','DATABASE_URL')) and len(value)>=8:
        values.append(value)
leaks=[]
for path in paths:
    p=Path(path)
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    content=p.read_text(errors='replace')
    if any(value in content for value in values) or re.search(r'\bsk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}',content): leaks.append(path)
if leaks: raise SystemExit('Potential secret found in changed paths: '+', '.join(leaks))
print('Secret check passed for changed and untracked files; no configured credential values or OpenAI key patterns found.')
